Flow.description: Automation inventory #9 (optional). Sets Priority from Severity x Customer Impact when a Case is created or either field changes, so Priority can drive entitlement milestone times. Matrix (Single User / Multiple Users / Site or Program / Enterprise or Mission): Sev 1: High / Critical / Critical / Critical Sev 2: Medium / High / High / Critical Sev 3: Low / Medium / Medium / High Sev 4: Low / Low / Low / Medium

formulas.name: fxPriority
formulas.expression: CASE(LEFT(TEXT({!$Record.Severity__c}), 5), "Sev 1", IF(ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Customer_Impact__c}, "Single User"), "High", "Critical"), "Sev 2", CASE(TEXT({!$Record.Customer_Impact__c}), "Single User", "Medium", "Enterprise / Mission", "Critical", "High"), "Sev 3", CASE(TEXT({!$Record.Customer_Impact__c}), "Single User", "Low", "Enterprise / Mission", "High", "Medium"), "Sev 4", IF(ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Customer_Impact__c}, "Enterprise / Mission"), "Medium", "Low"), TEXT({!$Record.Priority}))

Flow.label: Case Priority Matrix
